n10.rewritten_query: DPR ColBERT query document representations extraction dense retrieval bi-encoder late interaction matching
n10.hypothetical_document: DPR and ColBERT extract query and document representations by encoding them separately into dense vectors before matching. DPR produces a single vector per query and document, while ColBERT generates token-level representations for finer-grained matching.
